records.title: 分かれた道
records.body: 駅を出ると、線路はすぐに二つに分かれる。左は海へ、右は山へ続く。子どものころ、私はこの分岐点が好きだった。どちらを選んでも、いつかは同じ町に着くと聞いていたからだ。今、同じ場所に立って気づく。人生の岐路も、たぶんこれと同じだ。分かれた道が、どこかでまた出会うとはかぎらない。それでも、自分で選んだ道だけが自分の道になる。
records.english: When you come out of the station, the railway line splits in two almost at once. To the left it runs on towards the sea, to the right towards the mountains. As a child I loved this branch point, because I had been told that whichever one you took, you would reach the same town in the end. Standing in the same place now, I see it differently. A fork in a life is probably much the same. Roads that have parted do not necessarily meet again anywhere. Even so, only the road you chose yourself becomes your own road.
